core_responsibility: A PlayKit JS engine plugin that enables the Kaltura Player to display and playback static image media entries with optional timed duration support, simulating video-like playback controls for images.

feature_ownership: Image media playback engine for Kaltura Player
Non-durational image display (static images without timeline)
Durational image playback (images with simulated video timeline)
Thumbnail API integration for image loading and quality control
Fullscreen image quality enhancement (automatic higher resolution reload)
Simulated playback controls for images (play, pause, seek, playback rate)
Timer-based time update and ended event simulation
data_handling: Image source URL management and thumbnail API parameter concatenation
Timer state machine for durational image playback (currentTime, duration, playbackRate)
Player event dispatching (LOAD_START, LOADED_METADATA, PLAY, PAUSE, TIME_UPDATE, ENDED, SEEKED, RATE_CHANGE)
Kaltura Session (ks) handling for authenticated image requests
Fullscreen state tracking for quality enhancement

upstream: @playkit-js/playkit-js (core player library - IEngine interface, FakeEventTarget, EventManager, EventType)
Kaltura Thumbnail API (image delivery and transformation service)
downstream: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js (main Kaltura Player that consumes this engine)
playkit-js-ui (player UI components that display controls)
playkit-js-ima (IMA advertising plugin - pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll ads)

entry_points: src/image-player.ts (main ImagePlayer class implementing IEngine interface)
src/timer.ts (Timer class for durational playback simulation)
src/default-thumbnail-api-params.ts (thumbnail API parameter types and defaults)
